response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count FROM (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) AS media_type_stats;
